messages:
deploy-bot: kicking off progressive rollout: service=redwood-router version=1.8.0 -> 12% global (eu-west=5%, us-east=4%, ap-north=3%). change-window=2024-11-10T01:00Z. report anomalies here. :rocket:
nina: monitoring p50/p95/p99 and error queues. will call if anything looks off.
ops-oncall: seeing a tiny spike in eu-west 502s at +2m. pulling logs.
tomas: sample stack from edge proxy: `Traceback (most recent call last): AssertionError: invalid header length` on requests with reused connection pools.
carla: did we ship any header packing changes in 1.8.0? changelog mentioned different header serialization for routing metadata.
release-eng: yes, header schema bumped to v2 to carry routing tags. should be backward compatible but maybe older edge infra not accepting tag length.
ops-oncall: recommendation: PAUSE rollout and apply regional pin for eu-west to v1.7.9 until we assess. 502s at 2.1% from baseline 0.05% is concerning.
deploy-bot: current status: 12% rolled. To pause: `/deploy pause --id=rollout-1766674322`
ops-oncall: executing pause now.
ops-oncall: `/deploy pause --id=rollout-1766674322` -> accepted. applying route override: eu-west -> v1.7.9.
deploy-bot: route override applied. eu-west traffic pinned to v1.7.9 (5%). health checks passing.
nina: confirming metrics: eu-west 502s dropping to 0.08% within two minutes. good.
tomas: collecting failing req headers; looks like tag-length field set to 256 in some clients, edge buffer expects <=128. mysterious since unit tests passed.
carla: may be we missed a proxy side validation. action: add soft-fallback in router to truncate tag length and emit metric. low-risk mitigation while we patch upstream.
release-eng: drafting release note: "Staged rollout paused: header schema v2 causes occasional 502s on older edge proxies. EU pinned to v1.7.9; mitigation and follow-ups planned."
ops-oncall: prefer pin + mitigation. avoid silent truncation until we confirm no downstream semantics lost. do fallback with loud logs and feature flag.
tomas: will prepare a patch to add defensiveness and run a 1% eu-west canary after deploy-eng signs off.
release-eng: timeline: hotfix branch tonight, small canary tomorrow morning, full re-roll if stable. tagging infra and support.
nina: thanks all. closing immediate action. if error rate creeps back open thread and escalate. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollout paused by ops-oncall. current global fraction: 7% (eu-west pinned to v1.7.9).
